name: Goldie
description: Generates App Store and Google Play screenshots and preview videos by replaying app flows on a simulator, framing the captures, and validating them against store upload rules.

skills.name: Flow Replay
skills.description: Drives an app through scripted flows on an iOS simulator or Android emulator and captures each screen along the way.

skills.name: Screenshot Framing
skills.description: Frames raw captures into store-ready marketing screenshots at the exact dimensions each app store requires.

skills.name: Preview Video
skills.description: Joins recorded flow clips into an App Store or Play Store preview video and checks it against upload constraints.
